title: Mom called about visiting
summary: Jordan's mom called to plan a Labor Day visit, which sent Jordan into a self-conscious inventory of the apartment's flaws (broken door, ceiling stain, folding-table dining setup) and stirred up an avoidance he's been feeling about the October lease renewal decision. He kept the conversation light, skipping over the stress of the work reorg and settling for "things are good" rather than getting into it, while Pepper the cat defiantly perched on the counter throughout the call. No real decisions were made—Jordan is still stalling on both the lease and on being honest with his mom about how things are going.
